Description: Beter managed AWS deployment. Closed staging and disabled jobs by default; reviewed credits are required. Budget alerts are not a hard spend cap.

CreditsVerified.Description: Operator attestation after checking current eligible credit balance and expiry. Never assume credits from a prior account.

CreditCutoffAt.Description: UTC shutdown/review cutoff before verified credits expire, without trailing Z.

MonthlyCashCeilingUsd.Description: Net account cost alert threshold after credits; AWS Budgets does not enforce a hard spending cap.

StagingAuthorizationHash.Description: SHA256 of the full expected Basic Authorization value, never the raw staging password.

TestEmailAllowlist.Description: Comma-separated staging test email addresses. Empty denies every signup while launch is closed.

SiteOrigin.Description: Update to PublicGatewayOrigin after closed-stack creation when FreeGatewayHosting=true, otherwise to the custom HTTPS/CloudFront origin.

DatabaseEngineVersion.Description: Preflight must verify regional Data API, Serverlessv2 and scale-to-zero support for this exact version.

AlertEmail.Description: Operator email for SNS confirmation and net-cash budget alerts.

AcmCertificateArn.Description: ACM certificate in us-east-1 for the custom CloudFront domain.

EnableReservedConcurrency.Description: Enable only after verifying the regional Lambda concurrent-executions quota is at least 106 (six reserved plus 100 unreserved). Closed staging supports low-quota accounts without reservations.

FreeGatewayHosting.Description: Use the AWS-generated HTTP API HTTPS hostname with TLS 1.2 minimum, no purchased domain required. The optional CloudFront distribution is disabled in this mode.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Verify current eligible AWS credits before creating this managed stack; it costs more than $10/month without credits.
Provide a reviewed UTC credit cutoff date before credit expiry.
Retain completed hosted launch checks before opening access.
Staging cannot be opened as public production.
Public production requires the live provider.

Properties.GroupDescription: No inbound database network access; applications use the IAM-authorized Data API.

Properties.DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private database subnets without NAT or public routes.

Properties.Description: Least-privilege Beter runtime DB login, initialized by the reviewed migration runner.

VerificationMessageTemplate.EmailMessageByLink: Confirm your Beter account: {##Verify your email##}

Properties.Description: Beter process; disabled until migrations and configuration are verified.
Beter monitor; disabled until migrations and configuration are verified.

Properties.AlarmDescription: Missing or unsuccessful Beter WorkerSuccess; actual delivery must be rehearsed.
Missing or unsuccessful Beter ReadinessSuccess; actual delivery must be rehearsed.

FunctionConfig.Comment: Default-closed staging, hashed access check, and funding cutoff.

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'

PublicGatewayOrigin.Description: Free AWS-generated HTTPS site origin; HTTP APIs enforce TLS 1.2 minimum.
